sql: select 'order' k, o.market_ticker, o.side||' '||o.action||' '||o.limit_price||'x'||o.quantity v, o.status, o.created_at::text t, (select close_time::text from incentive_programs p where p.market_ticker=o.market_ticker order by last_seen_at desc limit 1) close from live_orders o where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-09-30 00:15' union all select 'fill', market_ticker, side||' '||action||' '||price||'x'||quantity, '', filled_at::text, '' from fills where filled_at > '2026-09-30 00:15' and market_ticker in (select market_ticker from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-09-30 00:15') order by t
